propositions: Five-level verdict: ALLOW (200 passthrough) / ALLOW_WITH_WARNING (200 + X-Governance-Warning header, forwarding uninterrupted) / ESCALATE (202 pending review) / DENY (403) / SUSPEND (403 frozen pending manual review — distinct from DENY semantics)
Explainability: DecisionRecord.rationale (13th column) derived from matched rule (rule={name}) or default description; lossless 12->13 migration via _migrate() ALTER
Injectable policy: create_app(config_path) enables test/multi-tenant isolated policy files; None keeps config/policies.yaml default
Chat full-chain: ALLOW_WITH_WARNING forwards to upstream with warning header intact (verified with live temp upstream LLM server — body transparently passed)
GATE 8 (critic runner): 5 critics parallel via asyncio + to_thread; verdict = HIGH veto REJECT / 2-3 MEDIUM REVISION / >=4/5 PASS
Zero regression: 329/329 tests (319 baseline + 10 new); GATE 8 real run 5/5 PASS
validation_scope.evidence: Full local run: pytest 329 passed (zero regression); GATE 8 runner 5/5 PASS; e2e intercept SUSPEND -> 403 + verdict SUSPEND; chat ALLOW_WITH_WARNING -> 200 + X-Governance-Warning + upstream body passthrough; _migrate 12->13 roundtrip anchored
